import BanachIsometric.RawTensorTotalDegree

/-! The genuine total-degree submodule is generated by the pure tensors of
singular simplex generators in the bidegrees with that total degree. -/

noncomputable section
namespace BanachIsometric.SingularAW

open SingularPrism
open scoped TensorProduct DirectSum

variable {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]

def rawTensorHomogeneousInclusion {n p q : ℕ} (h : p + q = n) :
    RawTensorChains X Y p q →ₗ[ℚ] rawTensorTotalDegree X Y n :=
  (rawTensorInclusion X Y p q).codRestrict (rawTensorTotalDegree X Y n) (by
    intro c r s hrs
    apply rawTensorComponent_inclusion_of_ne
    intro hpq
    apply hrs
    exact (congrArg (fun ij : ℕ × ℕ => ij.1 + ij.2) hpq).symm.trans h)

def rawTensorDegreeProjection (n : ℕ) :
    RawBigradedTensorChains X Y →ₗ[ℚ] rawTensorTotalDegree X Y n :=
  DirectSum.toModule ℚ (ℕ × ℕ) (rawTensorTotalDegree X Y n)
    (fun ij => if h : ij.1 + ij.2 = n then rawTensorHomogeneousInclusion h else 0)

theorem rawTensorDegreeProjection_inclusion {n p q : ℕ} (h : p + q = n)
    (c : RawTensorChains X Y p q) :
    rawTensorDegreeProjection n (rawTensorInclusion X Y p q c) = rawTensorHomogeneousInclusion h c := by
  simp only [rawTensorDegreeProjection, rawTensorInclusion, DirectSum.toModule_lof, dif_pos h]

theorem rawTensorDegreeProjection_inclusion_of_ne {n p q : ℕ} (h : p + q ≠ n)
    (c : RawTensorChains X Y p q) :
    rawTensorDegreeProjection n (rawTensorInclusion X Y p q c) = 0 := by
  simp only [rawTensorDegreeProjection, rawTensorInclusion, DirectSum.toModule_lof, dif_neg h,
    LinearMap.zero_apply]

theorem rawTensorDegreeProjection_component {n : ℕ} (p q : ℕ) (c : RawBigradedTensorChains X Y) :
    rawTensorComponent X Y p q (rawTensorDegreeProjection n c).val =
      if p + q = n then rawTensorComponent X Y p q c else 0 := by
  have h :
      ((rawTensorComponent X Y p q).comp (rawTensorTotalDegree X Y n).subtype).comp
        (rawTensorDegreeProjection n) =
      if p + q = n then rawTensorComponent X Y p q else 0 := by
    apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
    rintro ⟨r, s⟩
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro d
    change rawTensorComponent X Y p q (rawTensorDegreeProjection n (rawTensorInclusion X Y r s d)).val =
      (if p + q = n then rawTensorComponent X Y p q else 0) (rawTensorInclusion X Y r s d)
    by_cases hpq : p + q = n
    · rw [if_pos hpq]
      by_cases hrs : r + s = n
      · exact congrArg (fun x : rawTensorTotalDegree X Y n => rawTensorComponent X Y p q x.val)
          (rawTensorDegreeProjection_inclusion hrs d)
      · rw [rawTensorDegreeProjection_inclusion_of_ne hrs]
        change rawTensorComponent X Y p q 0 = rawTensorComponent X Y p q (rawTensorInclusion X Y r s d)
        rw [map_zero, rawTensorComponent_inclusion_of_ne]
        intro he
        exact hrs ((congrArg (fun ij : ℕ × ℕ => ij.1 + ij.2) he).trans hpq)
    · rw [if_neg hpq]
      exact (rawTensorDegreeProjection n (rawTensorInclusion X Y r s d)).property p q hpq
  by_cases hpq : p + q = n
  · rw [if_pos hpq]
    rw [if_pos hpq] at h
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun h c
  · rw [if_neg hpq]
    exact (rawTensorDegreeProjection n c).property p q hpq

theorem rawTensorDegreeProjection_restrict {n : ℕ} (c : rawTensorTotalDegree X Y n) :
    rawTensorDegreeProjection n c.val = c := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply DirectSum.ext_component ℚ
  rintro ⟨p, q⟩
  change rawTensorComponent X Y p q (rawTensorDegreeProjection n c.val).val =
    rawTensorComponent X Y p q c.val
  rw [rawTensorDegreeProjection_component]
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · exact (c.property p q h).symm

theorem rawTensorHomogeneous_linearMap_ext {n : ℕ} {W : Type*}
    [AddCommMonoid W] [Module ℚ W] {L R : rawTensorTotalDegree X Y n →ₗ[ℚ] W}
    (h : ∀ p q (hpq : p + q = n) (σ : RawSingularSimplex X p) (τ : RawSingularSimplex Y q),
      L (rawTensorHomogeneousInclusion hpq (Finsupp.single σ 1 ⊗ₜ[ℚ] Finsupp.single τ 1)) =
        R (rawTensorHomogeneousInclusion hpq (Finsupp.single σ 1 ⊗ₜ[ℚ] Finsupp.single τ 1))) :
    L = R := by
  have hproj : L.comp (rawTensorDegreeProjection n) = R.comp (rawTensorDegreeProjection n) := by
    apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
    rintro ⟨p, q⟩
    apply TensorProduct.ext
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
    intro σ
    apply LinearMap.ext_ring
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
    intro τ
    apply LinearMap.ext_ring
    let d : RawTensorChains X Y p q := Finsupp.single σ 1 ⊗ₜ[ℚ] Finsupp.single τ 1
    change L (rawTensorDegreeProjection n (rawTensorInclusion X Y p q d)) =
      R (rawTensorDegreeProjection n (rawTensorInclusion X Y p q d))
    by_cases hpq : p + q = n
    · rw [rawTensorDegreeProjection_inclusion hpq]
      exact h p q hpq σ τ
    · rw [rawTensorDegreeProjection_inclusion_of_ne hpq, map_zero, map_zero]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, rawTensorDegreeProjection_restrict] using
    LinearMap.congr_fun hproj c.val

end BanachIsometric.SingularAW
